recent.text: Another anemic night for #stlblues offense in 4-1 loss to #flapanthers on night honoring Keith Tkachuk. What can be done? Something has to give: https://t.co/HgbDJBhE1T
recent.author: Lou Korac

recent.text: Jim Montgomery said he had not heard anything regarding Aleksanteri Kaskimaki after the game but the #stlblues forward had an ice wrap on his left shoulder.
recent.author: Lou Korac

recent.text: Robert Thomas on intensity tonight: "I think it was low today. I think we all could have done a better job. As a whole, the game was lower intensity, especially in front of our home crowd, we've got to bring some more jam, especially on the bench. We've got to bring it more."
recent.author: Lou Korac

recent.text: Robert Thomas on what #stlblues can change: "That's something we're going to talk about. We've got two days here to regroup and come back Tuesday against Anaheim. ... We've got to look at some things and regroup and get ready to finish off this two-game homestand strong."
recent.author: Lou Korac

recent.text: Thomas on if it's entire group: "I feel like it's been an issue for quite a bit now. I think all of the guys, we've got to dig deep, find a way, whether it's changing something or guys loosening their sticks. We've got to start scoring 5-on-5 & just scoring in general." #stlblues
recent.author: Lou Korac

recent.text: Robert Thomas on the offense: "Not much. We're getting some looks, we're just not finding the back of the net and we're not creating enough looks. It's obviously been a struggle lately." #stlblues
recent.author: Lou Korac

recent.text: "After watching the tape tomorrow we're going to have a good, hard practice and we'll get ready for Tuesday night." Hear from Robert Thomas, Jake Neighbours and Jim Montgomery after a loss to the Panthers. #stlblues https://t.co/WnXHg0HTPL
recent.author: St. Louis Blues

recent.text: Jake Neighbours on #stlblues performance on Keith Tkachuk's night being honored in a pregame ceremony: "You've just got to come out with more urgency and match it and find a way to f--king create something." #stlblues He was obviously not in a good mood.
recent.author: Lou Korac

recent.text: Jake Neighbours: "I can speak for myself, I don't think I've been good enough and it trickles down." #stlblues
recent.author: Lou Korac

recent.text: There was obvious frustration, especially from Jake Neighbours postgame about offensive struggles: "There obviously needs to be a will and a want to go to the hard areas, make subtle plays to create offense. Just execution at the end of the day." #stlblues
recent.author: Lou Korac

recent.text: Monty on Broberg leaving: “It was more precautionary. I think he’s good.” #stlblues
recent.author: Jeremy Rutherford
